entries.condition: the label 'ATT&CK table, the claim sentence printed for <technique id>' of the verbatim text a procedure cell records where it prints the claim's first sentence; the agreement question is shown it as the passage's place, and the bundle names it beside a sentence of that passage left out
basis: the technique id the row prints

entries.condition: section 10 of the analyst report: 'No ATT&CK technique is published in this run.' where no row is published, and the line counting the techniques named and not published, before their list, where any is
basis: the capability matrix's published and not-published cells

entries.condition: section 6 of the analyst report: the protocol and endpoints subsection, the configuration table and the commands and flags tables, each table followed by the line counting the rows it leaves out, split by whether each row carries a finding the bundle marks it with, where any is left out
basis: the technical analysis's channels, configuration, commands and flags
the unresolved findings naming a configuration row
the flagged statements and the rows' own citations

entries.condition: the line under a table of the analyst report some of whose rows only the bundle prints: 'a check left a finding on' a row only where the row carries one (the bundle prints its mark), and 'its text is that of a statement a check left a finding on, and the row itself carries none' for a row left out for its text alone; both counted where both occur
basis: the rows left out that carry a finding (a finding naming the row's number, one recorded under the row's own citations, or a flagged sentence standing in a cell the bundle marks)
the rows left out only because their text is a flagged statement's
